title: Keep the delivery reason tooltip visible after Tab scrolls the reason into view
outcome: Keyboard focus reveals the delivery reason after normal browser scrolling brings that reason into view.
acceptance: Establish the behavior with actual Tab navigation into a historical row whose reason is its first focusable control and starts below the visible transcript. The full reason is available once the browser has scrolled it into view.
A focused reason previously visible still closes its tooltip if later scrolled out of the transcript, and Escape is forwarded.
